description: This file defines a set of animated tab components using React and radix UI primitives, with custom styling and indicator animation logic for active tabs.

classes.name: AnimatedTabs
classes.description: A wrapper component for radix UI Tabs Root with additional styling and ref forwarding.

classes.name: AnimatedTabsList
classes.description: A custom list component for tabs that manages animated indicator of the active tab, with resize and mutation observers.

classes.name: AnimatedTabsTrigger
classes.description: Styled trigger button for tabs, with state styles and focus/hover effects.

classes.name: AnimatedTabsContent
classes.description: Content container for individual tab panels.

methods.name: updateIndicator
methods.description: Calculates and updates the position and width of the active tab indicator.

methods.name: assignRef
methods.description: Assigns the DOM node to internal ref and external ref forwarding.
